name: PER_BOOKINGS
description: This table stores the booking details made for a person to attend an event or interview.

columns.name: BOOKING_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key. Surrogate key.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person for whom the booking to the event is recorded

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Refers to the event for which this booking is made. Foreign key to PER_EVENTS.
